title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_217.txt
concise_summary: PKD interprets the hypnagogic message 'the only living reality we have now is Philip the first' as evidence of a transtemporal immortal Brotherhood working through him as their sole earthly conduit in this moment. He develops a cosmological framework where the divine savior (Siddhartha/Apollo/Sophia) is about to be smuggled into the world unnoticed, time is collapsing, and his published writings serve a preparatory function in humanity's apocalyptic transition from sleep to wakefulness.
key_claims: PKD is 'Philip the First'—the initial and currently only living human vessel through which the transtemporal immortal Brotherhood operates as a viaduct in the present time period.
The second Advent is not a glorious public event but a covert 'smuggling' of a divine child (Siddhartha/Apollo) into the world as a cuckoo's egg, evading earthly authorities ('Scotland Yard').
Time itself is counterfeit and nearing its end; upon its abolition, the immortal personality partitioned across time will be refused into one transtemporal whole.
The macrobrain (unified consciousness behind reality) operates through message traffic and the Noos, coordinating the Brotherhood's temporal operations across alternate worlds and universes.
PKD's literary output (especially 'Ubik') and esoteric cosmology are deliberately synchronized with the imminent return of divine wisdom as preparatory works.
Dreams are not mentally generated but received from an external source demonstrating a distinct consciousness independent of PKD's own mind.
recurring_concepts: The Brotherhood—an immortal, transtemporal secret order descending from Christ, operating through host humans across multiple universes and alternate worlds.
The Macrobrain—the unified consciousness or unified field underlying reality; the source of living messages (contrasted with dead RF signals); operates through the Noos.
Living Reality vs. Dead Media—humans as living information outlets contrasted with mechanical RF communications.
Transtemporal Refusion—the re-fusion of the immortal personality's parts partitioned by counterfeit linear time upon time's abolition.
The Cuckoo's Egg—the Brotherhood's tactic of placing divine agents into ordinary human nests undetected.
Albion/England—the apocalyptic entry point for the divine savior into the world.
Phenomenal vs. Noumenal—the abolition of the many-ness (phenomenal world) to encounter the one (the macrobrain/Godhead).
Gnosis/Wakefulness—the transition from Part I (sleep/ignorance) to Part II (awakening/knowledge) in the Great Book of human history.
people_entities: Philip K. Dick—the author, called 'Philip the First,' the current viaduct for the Brotherhood
P.—mysterious figure abbreviated in the text, claimed to be part of the immortal Brotherhood ('because of P., I am one')
K.W.—person PKD jokes with, presumably a contemporary
Christ—the source of the Brotherhood's knowledge and powers
Thomas—historical figure cited as a receiver of immortality from Christ
Paracelsus—Renaissance alchemist/adept referenced as a model of esoteric knowledge and magic memory
Giordano Bruno—philosopher of hermetic magic memory systems
Bob Anton Wilson—contemporary figure mentioned as failing to understand the Brotherhood's transtemporal nature
King Arthur—mythological figure invoked as analogue for the returning divine savior
Orpheus—mythological figure whose descent parallels the divine child's smuggling in
Siddhartha/Buddha—divine savior figure waking from sleep (Part I to Part II)
Apollo—aspect of the universal divine savior
St. Sophia/Divine Wisdom—the returning feminine divine principle
Shiva—Hindu destroyer-god referenced as 'the eye' upon humanity at the end of time
The Pantocrator—Christ as supreme judge of the final assizes
Dorothy—possibly K.W. or another contemporary (referenced in title)
texts_works: Ubik—PKD's own novel invoked as a fictional prefiguration of actual esoteric cosmology
Tears—alternate world PKD suspects exists as Rome, possibly a reference to his own theological fiction or a visionary state
Planet Stories—magazine mentioned in dream episode
The Great Book—PKD's metaphor for human history in two parts (sleep and wakefulness)
The Books of Life and Death—biblical concept of judgment and final reckoning
autobiographical: PKD receives repeated hypnagogic messages while asleep, including 'the only living reality we have now is Philip the first'
He joked with K.W. about the Apollo sentence, triggering recall of a dream about a raft floating toward England with the divine child evading authorities
He experienced the 2-3-74 visions as a breaking of a partition between himself and a former/immortal self, not just a psychological event
He consciously tested a recent dream by trying to mentally generate content ('critical article on PKD') and found the dream unresponsive to his thoughts, proving external origin
He was filled with a cold moonbeam-like white light in his bedroom, left him and others 'painted in place, with nowhere to hide'
He saw his name entered in the Book of Life
He is experiencing acute existential terror at the imminence of apocalypse and final judgment
theological_motifs: The Second Advent—reimagined as covert and unnoticed rather than glorious
Apokatastasis/Refusion—restoration of the original unified state through time's abolition
Gnosis—the knowledge or wakefulness contrasted with sleep/ignorance
Divine Incarnation—the savior born disguised as ordinary human
The Last Judgment—the final assizes, the eye of Shiva, the Pantocrator, the closing of the books
Original Sin / The Prison—counterfeit time and the phenomenal world as a created illusion or prison to be destroyed
Sophia/Divine Wisdom—feminine principle of divine intelligence returning to Earth
Anamnesis—remembrance or recollection; breaking through transient self to recover the immortal macrosoul
Hermetic Philosophy—referenced as a possible framework for understanding the immortal person within
The Atman—Hindu concept of inner divine self, compared to the immortal person within
Christian Gnosticism—'immortal hidden transtemporal authentic Xtians' as agents of cosmic salvation
literary_self_ref: PKD explicitly states 'Ubik' prefigures actual esoteric cosmology: 'It really is true + it really can be done - all that happens in "Ubik" can be done! + is.'
He claims his exoteric publication of esoteric worldview (his novels) is synchronized with the imminent return as preparatory work
Alternate world 'Tears' (possibly from his fiction) is invoked as existing on a non-linear temporal axis: 'really exists or did exist in 1974, + yet is/was Rome'
His writing and the Brotherhood's activities are coordinated; his novels disseminate esoteric knowledge to prepare humanity
The dream of the raft mirrors motifs in his own fiction: divine rescue, evasion of authorities, passage across water to Albion
symbols_images: The Raft with Boy Philip—floating toward England/Albion, representing the divine invasion or penetration of ordinary reality
Scotland Yard—representing earthly authorities attempting to detect and stop the divine incursion
Apollo in Whitehall—the divine principle exposed to questioning by temporal powers
The White Moonbeam Light—divine or apocalyptic illumination filling the bedroom; total exposure and nakedness before God
The Sword Azoth—Paracelsian symbol of alchemical power and hermetic kingship; King Arthur's return weapon
The Mixing Board—metaphor for the divine's ability to splice alternate worlds and time-periods into ours
The Books Closed—the final moment when all judgments are sealed and history ends
The Silent, Flat Barge—the stately, silent vessel carrying the returning king/savior
The Cabin with Pills and Planet Stories—dream environment; refuge of knowledge and sleep before awakening
Albion/England—the magical/mythological place-name signifying where the incursion occurs (wordplay: Paracelsus, Albemuth, Azoth, Bismuth, White Fish, Water/mouth)
tensions: PKD wavers on whether 'now' in 'the only living reality we have now' means (a) at this time period, (b) currently available, (c) left alive after others failed, or (d) implies a decline from previous better states. He cannot resolve the temporal/existential weight of the phrase.
He alternates between thinking P. is a human individual and thinking the Brotherhood may be a 'multipersonal brain' thinking of itself in plural form—personhood itself becomes ambiguous.
He fears the apocalyptic implications ('I could get very frightened from this exegesis') yet intellectually affirms them; reason and terror pull apart.

He claims the immortal person is not universal (not everyone has one), yet invokes Hermetic philosophy and the Atman which suggest universality. Cannot reconcile individual exception with cosmic principle.

He asserts the dream contents are 'received' and externally generated, yet acknowledges the generator was 'deficient' at detail simulation—leaving uncertain whether it is truly external or a more sophisticated unconscious process.
He intellectually knows he saw his name in the Book of Life, yet is 'afraid' and depends on faith + trust; reason alone does not secure assurance.
evidence_quotes: "The only living reality we have now is Philip the first."
"I know they are immortal, transtemporal, + I know why + how, + what they do."

"It is quite some cosmology which permits the abolition of the phenomenal world of the many, + then encounter with the one, + its traffic of messages: its thinking - + to know we are very literally actually parts of this one."
"I have the strong feeling that the savior of us all is about to be smuggled into our midst unnoticed, to mingle with us as an ordinary human, which he is not."
"Time is ending, literally. Reality will now be exposed + all will become known: disclosed openly, + weighed."
"The contents were not generated by me, but received by me." + the generator was deficient in generating detail beyond a certain point, the simulation fell short.
uncertainty_flags: Identity of 'P.' remains opaque—whether a person, an initiate, or a code for PKD's own immortal self.
Referent of 'Tears'—whether this is a PKD work, a visionary state, an alternate world, or a literary allusion remains unclear from context.
The 'Metz speech' referenced parenthetically is not quoted or explained; its relevance to the world of Tears is assumed but not demonstrated.
The mechanism by which alternate worlds permit retrograde time travel is asserted but not explained, leaving the cosmology incomplete.
K.W. identity and role is unspecified; appears in dream interpretation but relationship to PKD's mystical activities is unclear.
Whether the Voice stating 'The head Apollo is about to return' is PKD's own thought, a hypnagogic message, or external communication is ambiguous.
The 'set/ground discrimination' requiring evolved color perception is mentioned as the Brotherhood's capability but never explicated.
Whether 'phylogeny recapitulated in ontogeny' (anamnesis) actually proves transtemporal immortality or is merely analogical is unresolved.
The claim that all Brotherhood members trace to Christ and receive immortality from him cannot be falsified or verified within PKD's framework; it rests on revelation.
reading_excerpt: "I have the strong feeling that the savior of us all is about to be smuggled into our midst unnoticed, to mingle with us as an ordinary human, which he is not."
raw_text: alternate worlds (e.g. "Portuguese States of America"!) In some way I don't understand the world of "Tears" really exists or did exist in 1974, + yet is/was Rome. (Cf Metz speech.) Folder 03 - 034 Folder 03 - 034 I know now that the brotherhood, which I suspected exists + worked through me, does exist + has been working through. I know they are immortal, transtemporal, + I know why + how, + what they do. But who they currently are I will never know, except that, because of P., I am one (he is one). If indeed they operate out of alternate worlds they may well be able to move retrograde in time, as it seemed to me in 3-74. That ability would allow them to operate into + out of alternate universes. I know they go back directly to Christ, + get their knowledge + powers from him, which no one (e.g. Bob Anton Wilson) seems even remotely to have guessed (nor re their transtemporal immortality + using host persons, etc, to jump back + forth across time). I just realized: they are informed + instructed + coordinated by the macrobrain via its messages -e.g. the bit in "Tears," that was the macrobrain- + it's living info itself! The brotherhood must have the set/ground discrimination, which has to do with an evolved color perception. __ Voice: "The head Apollo is about to return." See previous voice note p 24: "This is the hour you've waited for." Siddhartha is waking up? Folder 03 - 035 Folder 03 - 035 It is quite some cosmology which permits the abolition of the phenomenal world of the many, + then encounter with the one, + its traffic of messages: its thinking - + to know we are very literally actually parts of this one. The raft floating toward England - the little boy Philip getting past Scotland Yard - I was just now joking with K.W. about the Apollo sentence, + found myself saying: "A raft pulled by 6 (or 12) sea serpents floating up to England {Note} - Apollo taken off to Whitehall + being interrogated by Scotland Yard, + now there is no England-" + then remembered the dream. It sounds like Orpheus. (Dionysos, too.) Ist die Zeit da? Could the development + publishing widely (retrieval) of my (our) macro-microcosm cosmology be deliberately synchronized (in time) with the long-awaited "return" cited above (i.e. of St Sophia, Buddha-Siddhartha, "the head Apollo")? In other words, my writing is a preparatory step, one among many (e.g. the overthrow of Nixon)? {Note:} Albion Azoth England Paracelsus Albemuth Azimuth Bismuth White Fish Water (mouth of river or ocean) Every time I go to sleep now I again see writing. E.g.: "The only living reality we have now is Philip the first." (Like a pope?) This seems to express pessimism, as if the agency, the viaduct, right now is severely limited. To me? A very narrow + small outlet indeed. "Philip the first": perhaps the initial viaduct for the "we" to act through: a meager beginning, but still a beginning. Note Folder 03 - 036 the "we," not "I." Ah - "living" reality; i.e. the only present-time (see below) outlet in the sense of living (being present) now, rather than at another time. Also, "have now" could equal = "have left" [to "us"], or "now" could = at this time. "Only ... now" could mean that others once in use, formerly available, fell through. Or: the now could be contrasted to the future, not the past, in which case "only ... now" = so far, but it will later improve. They (the "we") could be losing ground or gaining ground; it is impossible to tell, but what can be told is, I think, that whoever "Philip the first" is, they are limited to him at present. Am I meant? "The first" points to this outlet as the start, not a falling off state of a previous, better process or outlet. So "the first" conveys a lot: it ties "only" + "now" not to the past but to the future. Thus "the first" makes sense as meaningful data: a process is beginning, not winding down. "Now," ; - = "so far"." "Philip the first" simply means, "Philip who is the first." ; "Philip, i.e. the first." So the sentence, so short, so laconic, opens up to mean, "we have so far only been able to take over a single piece of reality in this particular time period so far: Philip." Notice, too, it read "reality" not "person," which jibes with my notion that we as psychoi are irreal + are actually stations or places in the macrobrain. Wait. "Living" [reality] could be in contrast to non-living forms, such as communications media, RF signals, etc, which get cooked; "living," then, means person. "Philip, who is the first" [living reality that they have now, i.e. in this time period; otherwise interpreted, "living" + "now" are redundant.] Folder 03 - 037 Folder 03 - 037 Also, this ratifies my impression that a "we," not a single "I" is involved. "Philip, the first living reality to be taken over" as their outlet or agent. Boy, can I exegete a lot from this sentence! God, another interpretation occurred to me: "the only living reality we have now..." - "living" equally still alive; someone got the others, or the strain proved too much. No, I think it's living in contrast to outlets which aren't alive. Yet I sense, despite "the first" the sense of reduced to. (Because of "only..." linked to "...now..."). No, "now" means "at this time." No, "now" = "now left" not "at this time." I sense it: then "living" means "left living." "Now left" + "left living." + "the first" means that later hosts got wiped out. I could get very frightened from this exegesis of the sentence. No, "now" just refers to this time sector. I must remember that these are supra- or transtemporal entities so "now" doesn't have the ominous ring to it I supra supposed. Or could it mean "now available"? As in "available for assignment." I sense, "Now, for your use. Available to you" - a sort of inventory or map report. Re the Bowie film, + the little boy on the raft floating toward England; the divine child won't be born, but rather smuggled in, like a cuckoo's egg in a host nest, disguised as a - human? Terrestrial? Evading "Scotland Yard" - i.e., the authorities. Extraterrestrial? No. It has to do with time, + he can mix his world in + out with ours, like with a mixing board. Space + time both. But he is an invader - but God knows from where or when - but another planet, the future? +/or an alternate world? Folder 03 - 038 Folder 03 - 038 I have the strong feeling that the savior of us all is about to be smuggled into our midst unnoticed, to mingle with us as an ordinary human, which he is not. But where or when he comes from I do not know. I do know that immortal hidden transtemporal authentic Xtians are the "we" who will do this, but coordinated by the brain, + the living info (messages) of the brain + even by the Noos of the brain - up the hierarchal ladder of levels of reality. "We" may refer to the multipersonal brain; maybe it thinks of itself in the plural form because it is a multiplex system of interconnected (human) stations; or else a secret immortal brotherhood using host humans, + communicating with each other + one another via the message traffic of the brain. I sense that "Albion" or England is the place where they will enter the divine child into our world. Part one of the book -the part in which Siddhartha sleeps- has ended, + we can expect him to awaken. The second half now begins. It is St. Sophia's return: God's wisdom to Earth, born a second time, + this time he or she will be acceptable: will prevail. I am afraid because it is an awesome holy mystery + event, the most important event since the first Advent, abolishing counterfeit time + destroying the prison, freeing us + restoring us to what we once were + are supposed to be. I feel the terrible + vast majesty of the divine close at hand. Tremens factus sum ego et timeo. In die illa, libera me, Domine, qui tollis Folder 03 - 039 Folder 03 - 039 peccata mundi. Credo sed timeo. Apollo, Buddha, St. Sophia - the whole world will be drawn together by this, the universal divine Savior. He awakens now; he is nearing the shore - like King Arthur, returning from across the sea, to reclaim his rightful throne + kingdom, on the silent, flat barge, with the sword Azoth. Maybe what scares me is knowing that the books are closed or nearly closed - the books upon whose contents we will be given life or death: it's like that night when the cold moonbeam-like white light filled the bedroom + we were as if painted in place, with nowhere to hide. The eye of Shiva is upon us: herdsman + destroyer. Time is ending, literally. Reality will now be exposed + all will become known: disclosed openly, + weighed. We can only pray for rescue in this hour; the judge -the great assizes- is here: the Pantocrator himself. I must remind myself that I saw my name entered in the book of life. All I need is faith + trust. All I need is to know that I have an advocate with the Father who will never desert me. __ The 3-74 experienced, unleashed by 2-74, was the breaking of a partition between me + - what? A former self? No, I say, the immortal person. He cannot be defined by any one space, name or time. Whether this fits in with any system I do not know. (Hermetic?) There is an analog in the microcosm to the immortal world soul of the macrocosm. Perhaps it is the macro soul. Contracted, not analogous to it, but actually it. Folder 03 - 040 Folder 03 - 040 Then anamnesis, as phylogeny recapitulated in ontogeny means to break through from the transient self to the contracted form of the macrosoul, reflecting back the macrocosm, with all that it knows. The fact, actually, is that I don't know. It is, however, as if we (I extrapolate) contain an immortal person - but what system of thought teaches this? (The Atman, maybe - but no: this inner immortal person has distinct idiosyncrasies; he is a particular person. Perhaps this immortal person once was an ordinary mortal, but received immortality from Christ. Then I can't extrapolate to everyone. Thomas to Paracelsus to me. But Bruno knew of this magic memory. So I can extrapolate ... on the mechanism, anyhow. Suppose we regard this as the topology of the macrobrain, with P. + T. close to PKD but partitioned off. + the spacial partition was broken: parallel psychoi living in different times, the sum of which is transtemporal. What must be recognized is the counterfeit nature of time. With its abolition comes the re-fusion of the parts of the total (immortal) personality partitioned off into parts by time. The resulting refusion is, obviously, transtemporal. This is phylogeny in my ontogeny. __ My dream last night: Cabin, pills + copy of Planet Stories. Semi-conscious, I attempted to test out whether this dream world, so rich in detail, was generated by my mind. It was not. It didn't respond to my thoughts (e.g., I thought, "critical article on PKD," but none appeared. The contents were not generated by me, but received by me. + the generator was deficient in generating detail beyond a certain point, the simulation fell short. But anyhow it was presented to me, adventitiously. It was as stubborn + unyielding as "actual" reality.
